title: MissingReferenceException: The object of type 'CosmicShore.Gameplay.Player' has been destroyed but you are still trying
notes: Fix 2026-10-15 by claude: Same stale LocalPlayer handle as E-959befc35b, hit from the pause button: PauseMenu.OnClickPauseGameButton read gameData.LocalPlayer.InputStatus after the Player was destroyed. Fixed by the self-healing handle plus PauseMenu treating 'no live local pilot' as already paused instead of dereferencing it.
